page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries (Hebrew, Latin, Greek mixed), with the page number top right and a Hebrew letter heading top centre. No margin notes, no footnotes, no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: ולא יותר Nec minus, nec magis. פחיתות Diminutio: Defectio: Plur. פחיתיות Defectus, Prov.9.4. in Aben Esra.

פיט[?] Obloqui, Obgannire, Garrire: פטיט Garrulus. פטטיית Garrula: מפטפט בדברי תורה Obloquitur verbis Legis, כל פטטיא ביישין ופטטיא דאוריתא טבין Verbo Dei: Omnes garrulitates malæ sunt, sed garrulitas de verbis Legis bona est.

פָּטַר Discedere: פטר Dimittere, פטור Dimissum, Permissum, Licitum, Immune. נפטר Dimissus è vivus, Mortuus. התפטר כרבו Dimissus, Discedens à Præceptore suo. פטירה Discessus animæ ex corpore, פטור Dimissio, Repudiatio, Solutio: גט־פטורין Litteræ repudii. עטר פטור Litteræ solutionis. מפטיר Dimittens: sic vocatur, qui postremam lectionem in cætu sacro legens, populum postea dimittit. הפטרה Lectio sacra prophetica, quâ absolutâ, populus dimittitur: vide Abbreviaturas nostras: פוטירי ποτήριον, Poculus, Scyphus, Gen.40.1. in R.Sal.
פיט Poëta: פיט Idem. פיוט Poësis, Aben Esra, Psal.7.1.
פיס Contentum reddidit, Conciliavit, Placavit. פיס Quietatio. Item פיס vel פיס Deprecari, Petere, rogare.
פלא Mirum, mirandum. רופא מופלא Medicus admirandus: חכם מופלא Sapiens excellentissimus. פליאה Admiratio.

פלג Dividere, dimidiare. פלג Medium, dimidium, dimidia pars. הפלג Excedere, Excellere, Dissentire. מופלג Divisus, Separatus. בין מופלג סמוך sive conjunctum sive separatum. זקן מופלג Senex separatus, excedens ætatem fui sæculi. דעהו שהוא מופלג Scito cum excellentem esse. הפלגה Excessus, Excellentia sermonis, Hyperbole; זה על צד הפלגה וגוזמא Illud est per modum excessus.

page.notes: Several Hebrew words are small or blurred and are read with doubt, notably the first word of the entry on the Garrula line, the Hebrew forms on the Aben Esra and Gen.40.1 lines, and the Hebrew and Greek words in the פטר entry, which are marked [?] where uncertain. Running head is the Hebrew letter פ, which the page carries at head centre as a section marker. The Hebrew letter at the top centre is taken as a letter heading. The Latin "Dimittens" and "Dimissus" lines are read as printed. The line "ולא יותר" opens the page as a continuation of the previous entry.
